rows.notes: Convenience label. Used by this page to help name runs, but it is also saved normally.
Only letters, numbers, underscores, dashes, and periods. This becomes the run folder name.
Run folders will be created under this path by the backend.
Preview only. This is computed as output_root / run_name.
Keep false unless you are deliberately replacing a run folder.
Shared project runs use /proj. Personal scratch runs may keep this false.
Real runs should normally keep this false. Skeleton tests may set it true.
Normally true so later jobs wait for earlier jobs.
Leave blank unless the lab/cluster requires an account.
Used only when slurm_email is set.
JSON list of extra #SBATCH lines. Usually empty.
Keep true unless debugging unusual shell behavior.
JSON list of catalog paths or HydroMT catalog names. Use full catalog paths when needed.
Safety: at least one forcing should be enabled.
HydroMT discharge source name or configured catalog source.
CRS label for HydroMT build workflows.
Structures such as thin dams if configured.
Choose whether preprocessing should generate subgrid data or use a pre-made SFINCS subgrid file. Backend support may need to be added for this new key.
Subgrid pixels per model cell. Higher values can improve detail but increase preprocessing cost and storage.
Write depth/elevation diagnostic GeoTIFF during subgrid creation.
Write Manning roughness diagnostic GeoTIFF during subgrid creation.
Use river network information in subgrid generation when supported by the preprocessing path.
River source name in a HydroMT catalog.
Related roughness/subgrid behavior. Keep aligned with the roughness settings tab.
spatial = gridded/catalog rainfall; uniform = one constant rainfall rate; event_catalog_aorc = reduced-event AORC rainfall path used by hybrid workflows.
Used only for uniform rainfall. Blank saves as null.
Clip rainfall forcing to the model time window.
Water-level boundary source style. Native SFINCS is more naturally handled in Override Mode.
Clip water-level forcing to the model time window.
Discharge/source forcing style. Native SFINCS is more naturally handled in Override Mode.
Clip discharge forcing to the model time window.
Time column in the discharge time-series CSV.
JSON list. Empty means use all non-time columns.
Choose one of the supported/planned infiltration modes. Native SFINCS is usually for override/native-file workflows.
Manual SFINCS qinf file. Copies to sfincs.qinf and writes qinffile.
Manual maximum soil storage file. Copies to sfincs.smax and writes smaxfile.
Manual initial/effective soil storage file. Copies to sfincs.seff and writes sefffile.
Manual saturated hydraulic conductivity file. Copies to sfincs.ks and writes ksfile.
Manual Green-Ampt sigma file. Copies to sfincs.sigma and writes sigmafile.
Manual Green-Ampt psi file. Copies to sfincs.psi and writes psifile.
Manual Horton f0 file. Copies to sfincs.f0 and writes f0file.
Manual Horton fc file. Copies to sfincs.fc and writes fcfile.
Manual Horton decay coefficient file. Copies to sfincs.kd and writes kdfile.
Manual storage volume file. Copies to sfincs.vol and writes volfile.
Must be valid JSON. These keys are written as advanced SFINCS controls.
Can be a number or a string such as auto.
Set false only if you truly want warnings instead of stops.
Use true for final strict checking.
Prefer runtime paths inside the shared pipeline bundle when available.
Desired shared environment path. Use only after the shared env exists and passes smoke tests.
Desired shared Python executable. Current known-good fallback is still under /users/e/p/epsilon/... .
SFINCS Apptainer image inside the shared pipeline bundle.
Keep false by default; HydroMT file logging is slow. Slurm stdout/stderr logs still capture preprocessing messages.
Timing blocks already exist in preprocessing, but making this configurable from the web page requires a small backend/config hook. Not worth adding as a fake HTML-only setting.
